# Brand asset sources

The fox, panda, cat and seal PNG icons are size/format derivatives of the project animal artwork. The Apple touch icon is a size derivative of the fox artwork. Their project-artwork license is described in ../../ASSET_LICENSE.md.

The sound-high.svg and sound-off.svg symbols are Iconoir 7.12.2 assets. They retain the MIT license in ../vendor/ICONOIR-LICENSE.txt and are not relicensed under the project artwork terms.
